contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA RO-MANORVM ; D/ [DN V]ALEN-S P F AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Valens, AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA RO-MANORVM. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, dragging captive and holding labarum. Mint is Arles, AD 375-378. See LRBC p.56, no.539. Obverse legend reads [DN V]ALEN-S P F AVG. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: V/A/TCON.
